description: Run a one-off command (a seed script, a migration, a status check) with the environment one resource has in the stack, and return its exit code, stdout and stderr (the last 64 KB of each; values from the project's .env files are masked). It runs any command, so it is refused unless confirm is true: ask the user first. A container resource must be running (start it with `up`); a local-process resource runs from its folder. No input is passed. Names come from `resource_list`. Set projectPath when the MCP server is not running from the project root. CLI equivalent: `flisk run <resource> --json -- <command>`.

command.description: The program and its arguments, for example ["node", "scripts/seed.js"]

confirm.description: Must be true to run the command: it runs arbitrary code in the resource's environment

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

resource.description: Name of the resource whose environment the command gets

name: resource_run
